description: Shape of an `agent:context` bundle, so any consumer can validate a bundle without the router source.

properties.note: The task text exactly as given.
The bundle contract version. Matches `version` in this file.
ISO-8601. The only wall-clock value in the bundle.
{ intent, why } — the verb the router matched and the terms that matched it. The router's own confidence is reported separately in `confidence`.
Ordered strongest-first. UNKNOWN when nothing resolved.
FRONTEND | BACKEND | MCP | DATABASE | CLI | DEPLOYMENT | DOCUMENTATION | INFRASTRUCTURE | UNKNOWN
HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW
Human-readable justification for the level chosen.
FEATURE_MAP slugs the task resolved.
Indexes the router decided were worth querying, in order. Empty only for UNKNOWN.

The evidence the router resolved, keyed: components, services, hooks, symbols, routes, explicitFiles, features. Shape differs per key — components/services/hooks carry { how, strength, matched }, routes carry { kind, path, term, how, target, handlers }, explicitFiles carries { path, role, feature, importers }, and symbols/routes-features carry the matched terms verbatim.
Why the classification holds: matched keywords per category/surface, resolved features, subsystems, and the search terms used. Always present, including for UNKNOWN.
Ranked context files. See `fileShape`.
Markdown files to read first, in priority order, each { path, reason }. Mapped from the router's flat string list so the reason travels with the path.
Relationships behind the added files: { path, trigger, how[] }. Derived from expansionLog. There is no from/to pair — the entry names the added file.
Protected files the task touches: { path, tier, rule, via }.
Commands that must pass before the work is considered done.
One entry per added file: { step, path, trigger, how[], reason }. Empty when nothing expanded.
How many files expansion admitted. 0 when nothing expanded.
How many expansion steps ran, including the step that found nothing.

Free-form prose explaining why expansion stopped, naming the budget or the absent evidence. Not a token enum: the wording carries the actionable detail ("ask for a larger budget", "no remaining candidate has any permitted evidence"). Do not machine-match on it.

{ relevanceBudget, relevanceBudgetBase, relevanceBudgetExplicit, evidence[], expansionBudget, expansionSteps, safetyCeiling, safetyCeilingApplied, droppedByCeiling[], maxRelevanceBudget }. Makes the bundle state which budget applied, what raised it, and whether the runaway guard fired.
{ totalIndexedFiles, qualifiedCandidates, filesSelected, initialFiles, expandedFiles, selectionRatio }. The relevance/expansion split is derived from the FINAL file list.
Set instead of an empty `files` list: { why, searchedTerms[] }. Null when files were found.
Present only when categories is [UNKNOWN]. Carries why, askedForNarrowing and suggestion[].
